endpoint: WSA WSASQL freeform SQL, database=UHSDR3 (also tried UHSDR2)
n_points: 0 rows at target and 16in control (both uhsDetection and uhsSource)
quirks: Query mechanics identical to GPS and confirmed working (table/column introspection via information_schema succeeded, returning the full uhsDetection/uhsSource column lists). Positive control at high Galactic latitude (RA=180,Dec=30) returned 5 uhsSource rows in <1s, proving the DB/table/columns are correct and the service works. Zero rows at Cygnus-X is a genuine coverage hole: UHS is the UKIRT Hemisphere Survey's northern complement to VHS/SDSS, and like UKIDSS LAS it was designed to avoid the low-latitude Galactic plane, which GPS covers instead. Note astroquery.ukidss.Ukidss.query_region with programme_id='LAS' against database=UHSDR3/DR2 also failed outright ('Service returned with an error') -- UHS has no 'LAS'-named programme in that wrapper; the raw WSASQL route is required for UHS.

UHS has NO standalone VizieR mirror catalogue as of this check (2026-10-01) -- only a derived cross-match paper (J/AJ/170/277) turned up by keyword search. Must use WSA directly (see above) for UHS access.
